The main takeaway from our work is that
interpretable models can achieve state-of-the-art performance in the 3D human recognition domain.
interpretable models are not necessarily worse than the best performing models, and that interpretable models can achieve the best performance.
a simple and interpretable model can be as powerful as a complex and black-box one.
